items.title: Looking for Long-Term Economic Changes Doesn’t Improve Texas Land Forecasts
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: Texas land markets have gone through phases the past six decades, but do those shifts represent meaningful structural breaks?

items.title: Climbing the Housing Ladder Starts with a Bigger Step
items.author: Ryan Reed
items.content: Between 2015 and 2026, the typical starter-home price has risen from approximately $155,000 to $275,000, an increase of 77 percent.

items.title: What Texas Gets Right About Property Taxes for Seniors
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: The Texas tax code provides property tax relief measures to homeowners who are 65 or older.
